protocol.granularity: One independently assessable proposition. Split independent coordinated assertions. Keep a conditional rule with its condition and consequent. A source sentence used as a decomposition parent is not an additional counted unit.
protocol.unit_policy: Contextualize only from the supplied synthetic text; preserve who asserted, denied, or qualified each proposition.
protocol.qualifier_policy: Preserve attribution, negation, modality, quantities, time, scope, and conditions. Do not infer that a conditional event occurred or that a stated possibility is a fact.
protocol.equivalence_policy: Group only complete propositions with matching entities, scope, and qualifiers.
protocol.coverage_policy: These are separate synthetic protocol checks; do not pool them with the real-data reference or treat them as statistically independent evidence.
protocol.evidence_policy: Quotes are exact source substrings with zero-based Unicode character offsets; context evidence resolves references but cannot add assertions.
